generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All Terms and condition as per KW-2
Quoted rates should be excluding GST for all items

technicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should have satisfactorily completed one similar work such as providing and laying of UGD pipes to an extent of 25% of the cost of the work ie., Rs.9.12 lakhs (25% of amount put to tender inclusive of GST)

The tenderer should have in the last 5 years period achieved in at least one financial years an minimum annual financial turnover of rupees not less than the estimated cost under this contract (amount put to tender inclusive of GST) i.e, Rs.36.50 lakhs. Turnover, Profit & Loss account, Balance sheet statement certified / audited by a Chartered Accountant along with UDIN to be submitted. The UDIN is mandatory on all financial certificates
